payIDType.description:
PayID Type. Valid Values:
- 'PHONE’ Can be a mobile phone number or landline with area code
- ‘EMAIL’ Email address
- ‘ABN’ Australian Business Number
- ‘ORG’ Organisation Name

bsb.description: Bsb to validate. If provided, `accountNumber` must be present.

accountNumber.description: Account number to validate. If provided, `bsb` must be present.

accountName.description: Account name to check against the payId legal account name.
